name: Crossfade (xfade)
description: Transition from the first to the second input with any of FFmpeg's xfade transitions (fade, wipes, slides, circle/rect crops, dissolve, pixelize, wind, cover/reveal... and a custom expression). Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: transition
params.description: FFmpeg xfade transition name (or its number): custom uses `expr`; the list is in the README

params.name: progress
params.description: 0 = first clip, 1 = second clip (replaces FFmpeg's offset and duration); at exactly 0 and 1 the output is forced to the first / second clip

params.name: expr
params.description: Only for transition -1 (custom). Result for one color channel, 0..255. X, Y pixel position, W, H size, P = 1 - progress (FFmpeg's P: 1 at the start, 0 at the end), A and B the channel value of the first / second clip, 0..255, PLANE the channel: 0, 1, 2 = R, G, B
